# RelayWorks

> Boutique Software Engineering Studio founded and operated by Senior Software Engineer Hazrat Ummar Shaikh. RelayWorks specializes in production native mobile applications (Android & iOS), Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), high-throughput backend microservices (Spring Boot & FastAPI), custom Discord platform automation, and contextual AI assistants.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Native Mobile App Development](https://relayworks.dev/mobile-app-development): Production Native Android (Kotlin & Jetpack Compose), iOS (SwiftUI), and cross-platform Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) applications with local-first delta sync (Room, SQLDelight) and 60FPS fluid UI.
- [High-Throughput Backend & APIs](https://relayworks.dev/services): Scalable REST and WebSocket microservices engineered in Kotlin Spring Boot, Ktor, and FastAPI with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and containerized Docker deployments.
- [Custom Discord Bot Development](https://relayworks.dev/discord-bot): High-concurrency Discord bots featuring automated moderation, ticketing engines, economy systems, Stripe/crypto checkout sync, and custom gaming integrations.
- [AI Chatbot & Business Automation](https://relayworks.dev/ai-chatbot-development): Grounded vector RAG assistants for websites and WhatsApp Business Cloud API with zero hallucinations, CRM database sync, and calendar booking.

## Case Studies & Shipped Software

- [Karigo](https://github.com/ihazratummar/Karigo-App): Local-first offline invoice & rate engine for mobile field contractors built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose, SQLDelight, and RevenueCat.
- [Islam24](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hazrat.islam24): Native Android consumer application live on Google Play with ultra-low battery background engine (<1.5% daily) using AlarmManager and FusedLocationProvider.
- [OneDrop](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hazrat.onedrop): Reactive healthcare & blood donor network featuring real-time WebSocket state distribution, atomic claim processing, and Kotlin backend.
